description: Argentina Boletin Oficial search: official gazette notices with excerpts. 0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base); an unpaid call returns the x402 payment requirements. Free sample: textokit_sample.

date.description: Optional publication date, YYYY-MM-DD, selecting daily mode.…

limit.description: Maximum notices to read, from 1 to 10; default: 3.

payment_signature.description: Optional, legacy: base64 x402 v2 payment payload. Preferred: params._meta["x402/payment"]. Never a private key.

query.description: Nonempty keyword or search text, up to 200 UTF-16 units.

name: textokit_normativa_ar
